date_note: Date of the deportation flight as stated in the Manila Times (Tuesday, 24 November); the raid was on 3 November, older than the map window.
title: Philippines deports 139 Indonesians after Pasay scam hub raid
geo_basis: raid location (KE Tower, Cuneta Avenue, Pasay City) per the article
summary: The Manila Times reports the Bureau of Immigration deported 139 Indonesians on 24 November after a raid on a suspected scam hub in Pasay City on 3 November. Authorities rescued and profiled 166 foreigners, the article says. The Daily Tribune reports the police CIDG led the 3 November raid and describes an alleged parcel scam in which workers posed as police officers.
plain: The Philippines sent home 139 Indonesians after police raided a suspected scam centre in Pasay City, where investigators say workers posed as police to get money from victims.
exec: Per the Manila Times, 139 Indonesians were deported after a raid on a suspected scam hub in Pasay City.

evidence.quote: The Bureau of Immigration (BI) deported 139 Indonesians following a major crackdown
Authorities rescued and profiled 166 foreigners at the facility, including 138 Indonesians,

validation.note: Manila Times only (read). The article attributes its facts to the Bureau of Immigration and unnamed investigators; no BI release was read. Article gives 138 Indonesians among 166 rescued but 139 deported, unexplained. Follow-up 26 Nov: Daily Tribune (4 Nov) independently reports the raid and 166 rescued; it does not report the deportation, so that fact remains Manila Times only; no BI release found.

review.note: Compared title, 139 deported, 166 rescued, 3 Nov raid, CIDG and police-impersonation parcel scam, 24 Nov date against Manila Times and Daily Tribune; single_source note accurate; action fine
